issue.title: RefsLibrary follow-up coalescing test sometimes records an extra ref list call on macOS CI
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-66.5 note #2 (epic bob-cli-66). Investigate the intermittent extra `ref list` call in `RefsLibraryTests.testTriggersDuringRefreshRunExactlyOneFollowUp` (`Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsLibraryTests.swift:189-212`) on macOS CI. Root cause not established. Related flakes in the same CI run are already tracked as bob-cli-4k (StartPending preview timeout) and bob-cli-61 (RefsPanelModelTests refresh-reorder timeout).

task_type_fields.evidence: bob-mac-capture CI run 38010286522 ran three attempts on the identical SHA c4dc4b6 (idle-agenda work for bob-cli-66, which changes no Refs source or Refs tests). Attempt 1 failed `RefsLibraryTests.testTriggersDuringRefreshRunExactlyOneFollowUp` at `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsLibraryTests.swift:211` with `XCTAssertEqual failed: ("5") is not equal to ("4")` after 7.088s: the record had one more `argv=ref list` call than the three-trigger, one-follow-up expectation. Attempts 2 and 3 on the same SHA passed this test (they failed different, already-tracked timing tests: bob-cli-4k and bob-cli-61). Observed fail rate: 1 in 3 same-SHA attempts, under GitHub's degraded macOS arm64 capacity annotation. Serial or isolated reproduction was not tried (no macOS toolchain on athena). The test's comment says the follow-up pass reuses just-backfilled git dates and skips its git `ref list -g` pass. A plausible but unconfirmed cause is the follow-up starting before the git-date backfill publishes under load, so it runs an extra git pass. Confirm the root cause before changing the test's expectation or the RefsLibrary follow-up sequencing; do not just widen timeouts. Proposed by bob-cli-66.5 note #2 and triaged by bob-cli-66.land. Run: https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/38010286522
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: swift test --filter RefsLibraryTests.testTriggersDuringRefreshRunExactlyOneFollowUp (macOS 26; also observe the full CI suite)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-66.5 proposed this pre-existing Refs flake; the land audit confirmed a fail then pass on the identical SHA c4dc4b6, and no existing task covers this test.
